title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 37-40 (Lokashokavinashini, Dharmanilaya, Karuna, Lokamata)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 37 to 40: Lokashokavinashini, Dharmanilaya, Karuna, Lokamata, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 37 to 40 with meaning
caption: Names 37 to 40 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 37 to 40**: **Lokashokavinashini, Dharmanilaya, Karuna, Lokamata**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Lokashokavinashini, Dharmanilaya, Karuna, Lokamata.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

sections.h: Lokashokavinashini: Remover of the world's grief
p: **Lokashokavinashini** means **Remover of the world's grief**. Remover of the grief and distress of the world.
**Dharmanilaya** means **Abode of dharma**. She dwells where dharma is followed.
**Karuna** means **Compassion**. Compassion is her very nature.
**Lokamata** means **Mother of the worlds**. Like a mother, she nourishes all beings without distinction.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.

note: Written in our own words from the traditional list of names.
